war_summary: War 139 is on day 87 in conquest mode with no winner and 32 towns required. The front is split: Colonial forces hold full or near-full control in many regions (Acrithia, Allods Bight, Ash Fields, Callums Cape, Drowned Vale, Farranac Coast, Fishermans Row, Great March, Heartlands, Kalokai, Kings Cage, Kuura Strand, Linn Mercy, Loch Mor, Lykos Isle, Nevish Line, Origin, Palantine Berm, Pari Peak, Pipers Enclave, Red River, Sableport, Shackled Chasm, Stonecradle, Terminus, The Fingers, Tyrant Foothills, Umbral Wildwood, Westgate, Wresta), while Wardens hold full or dominant control in others (Basin Sionnach, Clanshead Valley, Howl County, Reaching Trail, Stlican Shelf, Viper Pit, Weathered Expanse, Morgens Crossing, Marban Hollow, Godcrofts, Speaking Woods). The heaviest pressure is concentrated in split or contested zones—Callahans Passage (W 8/C 2), Clahstra (W 6/C 2), Dead Lands (W 1/C 10), Endless Shore (W 7/C 3), Mooring County (W 2/C 10), Oarbreaker (W 7/C 2), Olavis Wake (W 1/C 4), Onyx (W 3/C 3), and especially Callahans Passage, Clahstra, Dead Lands, Endless Shore, Mooring County, and Oarbreaker—where casualty rates are accelerating and recent capture/loss events are frequent. Uncertainty remains high because several high-activity regions show zero recent ownership-flip events in the last 2h despite heavy fighting, and one base in Tempest Island is in NONE state, leaving strategic-base ownership vulnerable to rapid shifts in the next 24 hours.
